Description: Junction City adjoins Fort Riley, home of the 1st Infantry Division, in the Flint Hills of northeast Kansas. It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, Kansas's full exemption of military retirement pay, and affordable homes, anchored by a large soldier and veteran population. Tradeoffs include an elevated crime rate, no local Costco, and cold, humid-continental winters.
